x: S.L.H. had a strong team, led by Firth and Driver, who both ran well in the County senior race a week earlier, but they only came out winners by 2 points and were only 6 points in front of us.

S.L.H. had given it to Peter Driver another of their young but very talented members and he set up for them what proved to be an unassailable lead with a time of 28.52 which beat by 17 seconds the October effort of Pirie and Olney which it will be remembered was considered to be an almost fantastic effort.
Birchfield have had their days, S.L.H. are now riding high with Pirie and Driver at the top and now St. Albans City are appearing with O'Gorman and Thorpe as the examples.

It should also be recorded that other notabilities on this stage were Sando, Driver, Heatley, O'Gorman, Keily and Ingles, all of whom beat the previous record and all of whom gained assistance in battling with the opposition.
Baulch especially was in fine fettle to finish 11th behind such names as Firth, Caulder, Barrett, Towl, Maynard, Clark and Driver, all of whom are in international class in one sphere or another.

What is it about men like Firth, Driver, Pirie and company which enables them always to strike the front within half a mile or so? Pat Newell, running in his first cross country race this season, clung tenaciously to a good start and was always placed around the forty mark.
Firth and Driver who finished 4th and 2nd in the English 'National' could only manage 52nd and 60th and it was left to Perkins 34th and reserve Humphreys 39th to complete the six.
